chapter: Mellophone, Brunswick records and the West End Roof
title: High Society copyright and Bill Krieger's piccolo part
summary: He tells how Sousa's estate blocked his composer credit and that Bill Krieger took the orchestral piccolo part from the Library of Congress.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
